name: ETF Positioning page -- render DIVZ/IDVZ/PFDE/PFOE in the existing Positioning shape, with a Models<->ETFs toggle
description: Andrew-direct 2026-08-21 ~02:1xZ at the CTO~A terminal. Premise, his words: the ETF view 'will fold in exactly on top of the existing Positioning page. Simply instead of displaying the Models, we display the ETFs and their characteristics/holdings/etc. There is virtually no frontend work here involved aside from a clever toggle somewhere to flip between Models and ETFs. The real work will be procuring the data to be able to deliver that same shape.' Four commissioned steps: (1) find AJ's (CFO) daily US Bank email + download/assess attachments; (2) assess what the providers already give us in opal-data-etfs -- expected to yield 'proper weighted holdings on that basis for the Tree Chart' and the 'Holdings Breakdown' panel, with the UST/ST/INT/LT/ULT toggle bars swapped for DIVZ/IDVZ/PFDE/PFOE; (3) run atom-decomp on the Positioning page to pin the EXACT feeding data shape; (4) everything unfillable becomes a Bloomberg deliverable routed MSTR -> MSTR~Z, with the pull script modeled on the /terminal-upload Bloomberg scripts. RESEARCH LANDED 2026-08-21 (all four steps). HEADLINE FINDING: the US Bank EagleSTAR 'ETF-Opal-Reports' feed that prompted this covers ONLY PFDE (216630) + PFOE (216631) -- its own Verifications workbook Fund List sheet states 'Grand Total : 2' -- i.e. exactly the two funds we ALREADY hold holdings for; DIVZ/IDVZ appear in none of the four attachments (US Bank administers the Opal Capital trust; DIVZ/IDVZ sit on the TrueShares/Polen platform). So the new feed is a marginal gain (adds Investment Type Desc -> asset_class, and a coarse Domestic/Foreign geography axis) and does NOT close the gap. Andrew's weighted-holdings hypothesis CONFIRMED and exercised: silver/holdings already carries weight_pct, summing 99.99 (PFDE) / 99.98 (PFOE). The DIVZ/IDVZ holdings gap has two independent causes -- the deployed TS_HOLDINGS_ENABLED no-op (D4 finding) and the structural trust boundary -- and two independent remedies (issuer-side wiring vs Bloomberg pull) that must be priced against each other before either is built. Frontend correction: the model list is NOT a single constant -- 'UST' is hardcoded across 5 files under portal/src/pages/Positioning/, so the 'clever toggle' needs those unified into one book-set source first. Also found: the Positioning README is materially drifted from the served artifact (claims 35KB vs 8,150 B gzip / 73,487 B decompressed; documents a components/ dir, DurationTab and AttributionTab that do not exist; describes only one of the two live holdings forms). SECOND ANDREW-DIRECT 2026-08-21 ~02:5xZ, three additions: (1) snapshot check ordered -- EXECUTED EXHAUSTIVELY and the answer is NO: snapshots/ (70 objects) is FUND-LEVEL ONLY (today's is a 4-record JSON array, 2,876 B, no constituent array), and across 3 trees / 1,111 objects / 7,550 holding rows (all 69 silver/holdings files downloaded and every row scanned) there has NEVER been a single DIVZ or IDVZ constituent row -- source is 'filepoint' for 7,550 of 7,550, positive control PFDE=5,920; opal-data-assets/trueshares/ carries 0 keys matching 'holding' against 220 matching 'netassets'. The producer's own snapshot note gives the mechanism: filepoint ships an ETF_Holdings.csv, TrueShares ships only a netassets HTML page -- the gap is a source never wired to deliver holdings, matching the D4 deployed-bytes finding from the data side. (2) STRATEGIC RULING that unblocks the project, verbatim: 'clearly nobody has access to the characteristics, but that's fine, as long as we have the shape, we can get this done through Bloomberg' -- characteristics are now a DECLARED BLOOMBERG DEPENDENCY, not an open gap; our side owes the SHAPE, Bloomberg owes the analytics; the only real risk cell left is whether Bloomberg serves DIVZ/IDVZ constituents. (3) PLACEMENT -> SITEZ fabric. CRITICAL STRUCTURAL FINDING: this is NOT a new directive -- org/missions/DIRECTIVES.yaml ALREADY carries it as D4 ('ETF positioning variant', D4_ETF_POSITIONING_VARIANT_PRD.md), whose stance names its first act as 'a state assessment of the ETF data plane ... build-out honestly UNKNOWN'. THIS PRD IS THAT ASSESSMENT and the build-out is no longer unknown. So ETFS_POSITIONING is ADDED to D4's member set and D4 flips LAPTOP->SITEZ (reversing the 2026-08-19 ruling); minting a new D10 row would split one body of work across two rows. The row edit is SPECIFIED in PRD s.9.3 and REQUESTED of MSTR because org/missions/** is lane TIER0_MSTR ('MSTR is the SOLE writer') -- not a manufactured gate, and Andrew's own instruction pairs the assignment with 'alert 0.0.0_AB_MSTR'. THIRD ANDREW-DIRECT 2026-08-21 ~05:5xZ, PLACEMENT REVERSED: 'I thought we might handle this on the sitez fabric because they have the bloomberg access but it probably makes more sense to decidedly own it here and just have MSTR~Z specifically operate on a defined deliverable.' PROJECT IS NOW LAPTOP-OWNED; site Z executes ONE bounded pull. He also directed: read Yang's actual terminal-upload Bloomberg scripting, find what it pulls for the model Positioning shape INCLUDING time-span/history, and reappropriate it for the ETFs. DONE, and the live project turned out to be OneDrive-SYNCED AND PRESENT ON THE LAPTOP (%USERPROFILE%/OneDrive - Opal Capital/Shared - Documents/OCIO Models/Dashboard/202511 Model Portfolio Exposure), so the spec is read from Yang's own code rather than inferred. THE PULL: dc_return={price:PX_LAST, return:DAY_TO_DAY_TOT_RETURN_GROSS_DVDS} + dc_characteristic={name:NAME, fee:FUND_EXPENSE_RATIO, aum:FUND_TOTAL_ASSETS, num_holdings:TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_HOLDINGS_IN_PORT, te:TRACKING_ERROR, yield:EQY_DVD_YLD_IND_NET, duration:HB_OAS_EFF_DURTN, credit:YAS_ISPREAD_TO_GOVT, beta:BETA_ADJ_OVERRIDABLE}, via tia BbgDataManager.get_historical, daily, over date_end=BDay(-1) back to YearEnd(-6) = ~6 YEARS. PROVEN to be the Positioning source by TIE-OUT: 7 of the 9 dc_characteristic KEYS are verbatim field names in the served current_holdings[] rows (aum/beta/credit/duration/fee/name/yield), num_holdings at book level, only te pulled-not-served. CORRECTION RECORDED: an earlier draft read the project README as 'holdings come from YCharts templates', which invites the false conclusion that YCharts is a data source for the page; Andrew corrected it -- the Positioning DATA is Bloomberg via Yang's pipeline, and the Excel is OUR OWN model composition (usecols=[0,1,2] = Date/Ticker/Weight) supplying WEIGHTS ONLY. That distinction is load-bearing: weights are ours, characteristics are Bloomberg's -- and for the ETFs we ALREADY own the weights. KEY ENGINEERING FINDING (the grain changes): model books hold FUNDS, ETF books hold SINGLE STOCKS, so 4 of the 9 characteristic fields are fund-only (FUND_EXPENSE_RATIO / FUND_TOTAL_ASSETS / TOTAL_NUMBER_OF_HOLDINGS_IN_PORT / TRACKING_ERROR) and return correctly-empty on a stock -- 5 of 9 transfer unchanged; the fund-only four are still run against the 4 FUND tickers where they feed the book-level characteristics{} block. A naive re-point would read as a Bloomberg failure and is a category error.
